Light CWRGB Exported Functions

group Light_CWRGB_Exported_Functions

Functions

void light_cwrgb_driver_init(void)

Initialize the CWRGB light driver.

This function prepares the hardware interface and required configurations for CWRGB light control.

void light_cwrgb_enter_dlps(void)

Enable deep low power state (DLPS) for CWRGB.

Puts the CW RGB lighting system into a deep low power state to conserve energy.

void light_set_cold_lightness(uint16_t lightness)

Set cold lightness value.

Adjusts the light output level of the cold component, update lightness and lightness_last field.

参数:

lightness -- [in] Cold lightness value to set.

void light_lighten_cold(uint16_t lightness)

Lighten cold light.

Adjusts cold light intensity, update lightness field.

参数:

lightness -- [in] Cold lightness value to set.

void light_set_warm_lightness(uint16_t lightness)

Set warm lightness value.

Adjusts the light level of the warm component, update lightness and lightness_last field.

参数:

lightness -- [in] Warm lightness value to set.

void light_lighten_warm(uint16_t lightness)

Lighten warm light.

Adjusts warm light intensity, update lightness field.

参数:

lightness -- [in] Warm lightness value.

void light_set_cw_lightness(light_cw_t lightness)

Set CW (Cold and Warm) lightness.

Adjusts the light intensity for both cold and warm components, update lightness and lightness_last field.

参数:

lightness -- [in] The combined cold and warm lightness values.

void light_lighten_cw(light_cw_t lightness)

Lighten CW light.

Adjusts cold and warm light intensity, update lightness field.

参数:

lightness -- [in] CW lightness values.

light_cw_t light_get_cw_lightness(void)

Get CW lightness.

Retrieves the current cold and warm light intensity levels.

返回:

CW lightness as a light_cw_t structure.

Set red light lightness.

参数:

lightness -- [in] Red light intensity.

void light_lighten_red(uint16_t lightness)

Lighten red light.

Sets the red light intensity to the specified level, update lightness field.

参数:

lightness -- [in] Red light intensity.

lightness -- [in] Green light intensity.

void light_lighten_green(uint16_t lightness)

Lighten green light.

Sets the green light intensity to the specified level, update lightness field.

参数:

lightness -- [in] Green light intensity.

void light_set_blue_lightness(uint16_t lightness)

Set blue light lightness.

Adjusts the intensity of the blue light component, update lightness and lightness_last field.

参数:

lightness -- [in] Blue light intensity.

void light_lighten_blue(uint16_t lightness)

Lighten blue light.

Sets the blue light intensity to the specified level, update lightness field.

lightness -- [in] Blue light intensity.

void light_set_rgb_lightness(light_rgb_t lightness)

Set RGB lightness.

Adjusts the intensity of the RGB light components, update lightness and lightness_last field.

参数:

lightness -- [in] RGB component values.

void light_lighten_rgb(light_rgb_t lightness)

Lighten RGB light.

Sets the RGB light intensity to the specified levels, update lightness field.

参数:

lightness -- [in] RGB component values.

light_rgb_t light_get_rgb_lightness(void)

Get RGB lightness.

Retrieves the current intensity settings of the RGB light components.

返回:

Current RGB light intensity values as light_rgb_t structure.

void light_blink_cold(uint32_t hz_numerator, uint32_t hz_denominator, uint8_t duty)

Blink cold light.

Modulates the cold light at a specified frequency and duty cycle.

参数:

  • hz_numerator -- [in] Frequency numerator, frequency = hz_numerator / hz_denominator Hz, range: 1/13 ~ 2.5K.

  • hz_denominator -- [in] Frequency denominator, frequency = hz_numerator / hz_denominator Hz, range: 1/13 ~ 2.5K.

  • duty -- [in] High duty cycle percentage.

void light_blink_warm(uint32_t hz_numerator, uint32_t hz_denominator, uint8_t duty)

  • hz_denominator -- [in] Frequency denominator, frequency = hz_numerator / hz_denominator Hz, range: 1/13 ~ 2.5K.

  • duty -- [in] High duty cycle percentage.
